title: Triage the open bug reports
intro: Three reports from the tracker. Each says what is wrong today, what would change, and what I suggest. My suggestion is preselected.

questions.text: **Report 412: the CSV export hangs on large projects.** Today the export builds the whole file in memory and the request times out after 30 seconds for projects with more than 50,000 rows. It would stream the rows, so the first bytes arrive at once. My take: it affects the three largest customers, and streaming is a day of work.

questions.text: **Report 398: the logo is unreadable in dark mode.** Today the logo is a dark grey SVG on a dark background. It would use the light variant, which exists already. My take: a one-line fix in the stylesheet, so there is little to weigh.

**Report 377: a plugin API for custom exporters.** Today exporters are built in. It would let a plugin register one. My take: one person asked, in 2023, and the reporter has not answered since. It is a large change for a request nobody repeated.
